cvText:
Alex Morgan
Email: alex.sample@example.com
EDUCATION
Loughborough University — BA English, 2023–2026. Predicted 2:1.
EXPERIENCE
Campus Bar — Team Member, 2024–present
Served customers during evening shifts and checked till totals with the supervisor at close.
When an order was entered twice, checked the receipt and asked the supervisor to correct it.
Worked with colleagues to prioritise outstanding orders during busy periods.
ACTIVITIES
Literature Society — Events Volunteer, 2025
Compared room availability and prices for a reading event and recorded options in a spreadsheet.
Presented the options to the society committee; the committee selected the venue.
Helped organise sign-in on the day and answered attendees’ questions.
PROJECTS
English dissertation, 2026
Compared three authors’ treatment of unreliable narration and documented sources in an evidence table.
Revised the argument after tutor feedback and presented the revised structure to a seminar group.
SKILLS
Research, written communication, Excel spreadsheets, teamwork. No finance internship or financial modelling project.
